dialogues.speaker: Ismenor
dialogues.text: Good evening. Are you out here on a stroll as well?

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: The night views are quite nice.

dialogues.speaker: Ismenor
dialogues.text: Haha, well now, that's not something you see every day — a young person with the same tastes as a retiree like myself.

dialogues.speaker: Ismenor
dialogues.text: The young lads and lasses are all like this continuously-moving statue in the middle of the plaza.

dialogues.speaker: Ismenor
dialogues.text: They're full of energy, yet they often know not what they do anything for.

dialogues.speaker: Ismenor
dialogues.text: Forgive my pessimism — it might be on account of my past as a Champion Duelist.

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: Tell me about the Champion Duelists...

dialogues.speaker: Ismenor
dialogues.text: It is a profession that exists to maintain dignity, yet lives alongside conflict.

dialogues.speaker: Ismenor
dialogues.text: Suspects who do not believe that they should have to stand trial will request a duel to defend their reputation.

dialogues.speaker: Ismenor
dialogues.text: Only concession or expiry can end a duel, and there are few who can defeat official Champion Duelists.

dialogues.speaker: Ismenor
dialogues.text: So I doubt it would be hard for you to imagine what happens to such suspects.
